rationale: Ula is bringing embodied AI robotics to market as a founding GTM & Ops leader, while Arjun is a software engineer actively building in AI research with strong technical chops (Python, TypeScript, Java). Arjun's background in AI research and developer tools complements Aora Mind's need for technical depth on the engineering side, and Ula's go-to-market experience could help shape how AI research gets productized into real tools.
intro_message: Ula LI, meet Arjun Rawat — he's a software engineer exploring AI research and developer tools who could bring technical firepower to embodied AI robotics, while you could offer him insights into bringing research projects to market.
